title: Customer Skips on a Shared Household Food Tailwise Autoship
content:
Customer-requested skips lengthen the days between shipments of a shared household food Autoship under Tailwise Autoship (a non-prescription food subscription that feeds more than one pet of the household).

| Skips the customer requested on the subscription in the last twelve months | Days added to the days between shared household food shipments |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 21 |
| exactly 1 | 14 |
| none | none |

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

Only skips the customer requested count; skips booked automatically for a backorder do not.

**Hypothetical record.** One customer skip eleven months ago and one exactly twelve months ago: one counts, 14 days are added. Three customer skips in the last year: 21 days are added.
